metric_explanations.defect_detection_rate_percent: Failing/error tests divided by total executed tests. Higher means defects are found with fewer tests.

metric_explanations.number_of_tests_executed: Total pytest outcomes counted from the final pytest summary: passed + failed + errors + skipped + xfailed + xpassed.
metric_explanations.test_reduction_percentage: How many fewer tests were executed compared with the traditional target-test baseline.
metric_explanations.pass_rate_percent: Passed tests divided by total executed tests.
metric_explanations.generated_test_validity_rate_percent: Agentic only: generated tests that executed without collection/runtime infrastructure errors. Failing assertions still count as valid defect-detection tests.
metric_explanations.coverage_improvement_percent: Coverage difference compared with the traditional target-test baseline.
metric_explanations.selection_accuracy_percent: Selected test files that directly target the source module divided by all selected test files.
metric_explanations.manual_effort_proxy_minutes: Transparent proxy estimate from executed tests/heal attempts. Use only as an automation-effort indicator, not measured human time.
metric_explanations.efficiency_score_percent: Weighted index from defect density, test reduction, execution saving, coverage, pass rate, and selection accuracy.
